title: Measuring What a Specification Determines: A Formal Semantic-Block Model and an Execution-Judged Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2608.19475v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work introduces a formal semantic-block model for specifications and an execution-judged benchmark for evaluating specification quality independently of model capability. A specification is represented as a structure comprising semantic blocks, dependency relations, block-owned rules, decision points, and explicitly open questions, subject to four machine-checkable well-formedness conditions: acyclicity, single ownership, constraint domination, and totality or ambiguity-stop. Determinacy is defined model-theoretically as agreement among all conforming implementations and is estimated empirically through convergence across independent implementers. The model is instantiated on an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration specification containing 18 blocks and 19 dependency edges. translated_title: 衡量规范所确定的内容：一种形式化语义块模型与执行判定基准
translated_abstract: 本工作引入了一种用于规范的形式化语义块模型，以及一个独立于模型能力的执行判定基准，用于评估规范质量。规范被表示为一种结构，包含语义块、依赖关系、块自有规则、决策点和显式开放问题，并需满足四个机器可检查的良构条件：无环性、单一所有权、约束支配性以及完全性或歧义停止。确定性在模型理论层面定义为所有符合实现之间的一致性，并通过独立实现者之间的收敛性进行实证估计。该模型在一个Oracle到PostgreSQL迁移规范上实例化，包含18个块和19条依赖边。计算验证表明，五层分解通过依赖闭包将每个任务的平均上下文减少了约71%，覆盖了85.5%的...
tldr: 本文提出了一种形式化语义块模型和执行判定基准，通过结构分解和依赖闭包显著降低任务上下文并评估规范质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a formal semantic-block model and an execution-judged benchmark that reduces per-task context by about 71% via dependency closures and evaluates specification quality.
